definitions.explanation: The fleshy parts forming the edges of the mouth.

examples.japanese: {唇|くちびる}が{乾|かわ}いている。
{赤|あか}い{口紅|くちべに}を{唇|くちびる}に{塗|ぬ}る。
examples.english: Apply red lipstick to the lips.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{唇|くちびる}を{噛|か}んで{黙|だま}っていた。
examples.english: She bit her lip and stayed silent.

notes:
{唇|くちびる} refers to the lips of the mouth.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {唇|くちびる}を{噛|か}む (to bite one's lip)
- {唇|くちびる}を{尖|とが}らせる (to pout)
- {唇|くちびる}が{荒|あ}れる (lips become chapped)
- {上唇|うわくちびる} (upper lip)
- {下唇|したくちびる} (lower lip)

RELATED VOCABULARY:
- {口|くち} (mouth)
- {口紅|くちべに} (lipstick)
- リップクリーム (lip balm)
